title: Blob integration + interaction + performance + README — the WCAG-2.2.2 pause seam made REAL, demand-gate quiescence, multi-instance context cap, one var()-unwrap leaf, the canonical README, + the W15 four-side carry
status: dev-complete — headless self-gates GREEN (typecheck + 17 blob/dom units + all structural proof:* gates) AND the LIVE π-lane GREEN on the real Metal GPU (proof:blob-integration 3/0, proof:blob-render 3/0); the orchestrator re-runs the π-lane on the real device as the binding close.

ratify.decision: v-model:paused (RATIFIED — the recommended path b) — AND pause()/resume() re-exposed (the fallback path a) on TOP of it, because the README worked example + the demo stories + the DockBackgroundToggle JSDoc all carry imperative blob.value?.pause() call sites that must keep working.
ratify.rationale: The v-model:paused prop OWNS the default (structurally un-droppable — a discarded renderer return cannot recur), matching the AV.W7 G2 @update:paused contract the DockBackgroundToggle was built against + Aurora's useAurora pause/resume parity. The imperative pause()/resume() handles flip the SAME paused model (they emit update:paused), so there is NO parallel pause path — one seam, two affordances. The renderer watches the resolved `paused` ref and suspends/resumes the EXISTING substrate 'manual' lifecycle reason.
ratify.publicSurfaceDelta: GooBlob gains a `paused` prop (v-model) + a `quality` prop + an `update:paused` emit; defineExpose adds pause/resume/pulse (pulse was already a method, now exposed). types.ts adds the BlobQuality union. No length/geometry/smoothK/POS_SCALE constant touched (W08/W15 own the distance regime, §4 note 13).

arms.arm2_quiescence: Replaced shouldContinue(){return !paused} with a REAL at-rest predicate: live IFF !pointer.atRest() || !mood.settled() || satellites.anyTransitioning(). When all settle the loop PARKS; scheduleQuiescenceWake() arms a setTimeout for the next satellite phase boundary (satellites.msUntilNextPhase / tempo) so it re-renders the merge/emerge event on time. Wired quality:'full'|'half' (half = HALF backing-store resolution + free canvas bilinear-upsample, ~4× fragment savings). NEW predicates: useBlobMood.settled(), useBlobPointer.atRest(), useBlobSatellites.anyTransitioning()/msUntilNextPhase() — all READ-ONLY seams over EXISTING state (no speculative config).

arms.arm5_perfTrim: Pre-FBM bounding early-out in metaball.frag.ts: a TRANSPARENT WRITE (not GLSL discard — discard kills the mobile tiled-renderer fast path) when dot(uv,uv) > uMaxReach², BEFORE the two 3-octave FBM evals + the OKLCh round-trip. uMaxReach is CPU-computed PADDED by the satellite envelope (orbit×1.2×(1+ecc) + worst wobble + pertY + satRadius), the squash-stretched body, the smin band, the noise amp, ×POS_SCALE ×1.25 headroom (≈0.544 uv vs the worst painted reach ≈0.435 uv — never clips the wet meniscus). The 4-tap surfaceNormal gate is a NO-OP: W15 already landed the analytic-gradient normal (surfaceNormalFromGrad reads sceneDistG directly, no 4-tap to gate). The oversize-canvas trim is the maxReach cull (the corner triangles beyond 0.544 uv skip the field).
arms.arm6_offScreenIo: createCanvasLifecycle.ts CanvasSuspendReason gains the DISTINCT 'off-screen-io' key; the blob's IntersectionObserver fallback writes 'off-screen-io' (not 'off-screen'), disjoint from the content-visibility 'off-screen' — an IO resume can no longer lift a legitimately-skipped CV suspend (the one-writer-per-reason invariant is literally true). useWebGLCanvas.ts WebGLSuspendReason re-states the union member-equal to the lifecycle core (pinned by a build-time satisfies-parity const).

criticalRuntimeFinding_falseParkBug.theW01Lesson: The headless self-gates (typecheck + units + structural) were ALL GREEN, but the LIVE π-lane (proof:blob-integration on the real Metal GPU) caught a real runtime bug: a QUIESCED (demand-gate-parked) blob was FROZEN to interaction — a hover/click set the lean/pulse state on a parked rAF that never re-rendered. The click bounce did not render (running click-bounce body delta read 0.0000 where it should read ≈0.58).
criticalRuntimeFinding_falseParkBug.rootCause: The quiescence gate parked the loop, but useBlobPointer.onPointerMove/click only updated refs — NOTHING called canvasHandle.wake(), so the parked loop never re-armed on interaction (the exact 'false-park / frozen-then-jerk' hazard the SOTA research [22][14] flags).
criticalRuntimeFinding_falseParkBug.fix: useBlobPointer.setActivityHandler(cb) — a settable hook the RENDERER registers as () => canvasHandle?.wake(); onPointerMove + click fire it. The loop is now event-scheduled (parks at rest, wakes on the satellite phase scheduler) AND interaction-responsive (wakes instantly on hover/click). A paused blob's interaction wake is a no-op (isRunning() is false under the 'manual' suspend), so pause still beats interaction.
criticalRuntimeFinding_falseParkBug.verifiedLive: After the fix proof:blob-integration is 3/0 GREEN: running click-bounce ≥ 0.05, paused click-bounce ≤ 0.01, resumed click-bounce ≥ 0.05.

quiescencePredicate.atRest_pointer: no active cursor AND |springVel| < 0.01 on both axes AND trail collapsed (trailLen===0) AND pulse oscillator zeroed
quiescencePredicate.settled_mood: NOT mid cross-fade AND no excited-hold latch (the homeostatic decay REACHES a fixed point and stops — not a perpetual micro-drift)
quiescencePredicate.anyTransitioning_satellites: ANY satellite is mid-merge or mid-emerge (orbiting/absorbed are the stable resting phases the loop may park through)
quiescencePredicate.wake: scheduleQuiescenceWake() arms setTimeout(canvasHandle.wake, msUntilNextPhase/tempo) on park; interaction wakes via setActivityHandler; color/quality changes wake via watchers. No false-park: every motion source is ORed; the parked orbit re-renders on the next phase edge.

w15Carry_fourSideReconciliation.groundTruth: At HEAD e32d944 the original blob-render.spec.ts FOUR-SIDE assertion measured worst-edge 0.500 at FOOTPRINT_INSET and failed the 0.35 ceil. Re-measured live: that 0.500 is an INTERMITTENT satellite PEEK (the satellite orbit is 8-14s; a short sample reads 0.000, a 9s driven sweep reads 0.523). The orbiting satellites INTENTIONALLY overflow the footprint — the canvas is CSS-sized 160% of the wrapper with overflow:visible PRECISELY for this. It is a PEEK, NOT a body clip.
w15Carry_fourSideReconciliation.reconciliation: RE-DERIVED the four-side gate ceil to the design's intentional-overflow budget (option 2 of the wave spec): FOOTPRINT_PEEK_MAX_FRAC 0.35 → 0.6 (bounds the measured ≈0.52 peek). A BODY clip is distinguished by the EXISTING battery — the COVERAGE ceil (a flood reads ≈0.74), the centre-vs-corner GRADIENT (a slab has none), and the painted CENTROID staying centred (a one-sided clip shifts it). The LITERAL CANVAS edge is NOT sampled: the goo-blob cells are rounded-card overflow-hidden, so a literal-edge ring reads the rounded-card CLIP border (a fixed ≈0.5 dark fraction INVARIANT to the blob — the exact confound the W08 modal-bg + interior-inset design avoids). The wrapper FOOTPRINT ring sits INSIDE that clip on the clean cream field.
w15Carry_fourSideReconciliation.rejectedFirstAttempt: An initial reconciliation added a CANVAS_EDGE_INSET=0.02 'hard clip' ring; the live measurement proved it reads the rounded-card clip border (0.558 even at threshold 100, invariant to the blob) — a re-introduction of the exact confound W08 designed around. Removed. The drop-shadow + rounded-card clip make any literal-canvas-edge ring useless; the body containment is proven by coverage/gradient/centroid.
w15Carry_fourSideReconciliation.preserved: The lit dome (std ≥ 9), silhouette CV (≥ 0.015), coverage in band, hover-flick lean (≥ 0.012), both-mode legibility — all VERIFIED unchanged by the W16 edits (proof:blob-render 3/0 GREEN on the real Metal GPU).
